text: The 5-term exact sequence $0\to H^1(Q,M^N)\to H^1(G,M)\to H^1(N,M)^Q\to H^2(Q,M^N)\to H^2(G,M)$ extracted from the low-degree terms of the LHS spectral sequence is called the:
choices: long exact sequence of a pair
explanation: This low-degree 5-term sequence is the inflation-restriction exact sequence in group cohomology (its first map is inflation, its third is restriction). The long exact sequence of a pair and the universal coefficient theorem arise from different constructions, and the Kunneth sequence relates the homology of a tensor product, not extensions of groups.
